scope: All 297 entries currently listed in the Music Dictionary Music Concepts tables; hidden legacy Tonality, merged Tuned/Untuned records and Music Literacy-only entries are excluded.
method: A concept is present once per paper if it is a credited listening or score-reading response, a named accepted alternative, or a feature in the published answer/analytical lists. Required paired features count as appearances even when not creditable alone. Named intervals and chord-identification tasks are mapped to their matching dictionary entries. No marks-weighting or repeat-question weighting. General marking examples, rejected answers, lyrics, background prose and incidental words are excluded.
mapping_notes: Every qualification includes all listed dictionary concepts, including zero-frequency and above-level accepted alternatives.
Introductory qualification labels are curriculum labels, not restrictions on which marking instructions can accept a term.
Repeated Octave, Subject and Compound time entries share occurrences. Different explicitly distinguished answers, such as Arco/Bowing and Modulation/Change of key, are not silently merged.
Specific named chord types do not also credit generic Chord. Piano trio does not independently credit Piano; symphony orchestra does not credit Symphony; mezzo forte does not credit Mezzo-soprano.
Score-only note names, rests, clefs, barlines, key signatures, dynamics and durations are not separate rows. A named concept that also appears in the Music Concepts table is retained.
Episode is included under Rondo/ABACA — episode (MC-0189); the standalone MC-0185 entry is retired.
